scanner_c.notes: Previous-24h financial-news scan for the Sep 16 Toronto morning across the U.S., mainland China/Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Europe. Technology, AI/semiconductors and U.S.-equity relevance were prioritized while also scanning macro, M&A, policy and supply chains. Major claims were verified primarily with Reuters. Ten distinct topics retained without duplicate padding.

items.event_title: Markets brace for expected Fed rate hike as 10-year Treasury yield trades around 5%
items.news_summary: Markets entered the Fed decision expecting a quarter-point rate hike, with the 10-year Treasury yield around the 5% area as oil-driven inflation and policy credibility dominate trading.
items.investor_materiality: Direct valuation and discount-rate catalyst for U.S. equities, especially long-duration technology stocks, while also affecting the dollar, bonds, gold and oil.
items.selection_reason: The Fed decision is the day's dominant cross-asset catalyst and has unusually clear implications for U.S.-stock investors.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters market coverage; corroborated by multiple major financial outlets in Scanner B discovery.
items.youtube_query: Fed rate hike Treasury yield 5 percent September 2026

items.event_title: SK hynix and Intel linked to potential first U.S. memory-chip production arrangement
items.news_summary: Reuters reporting cited talks that could bring SK hynix memory-chip production to Intel facilities in the U.S.; subsequent Korean reporting said SK hynix denied production rumors, making the exact structure important to verify.
items.investor_materiality: Potentially material for Intel fab utilization, U.S. semiconductor localization and the global HBM/memory supply chain.
items.selection_reason: A high-burst semiconductor supply-chain story directly linking the world's second-largest memory producer with Intel's U.S. manufacturing footprint.
references: Reuters exclusive headline captured in fresh Scanner B evidence, Sep 16 2026; Korea Herald follow-up denial
items.source_quality_note: Reuters-origin report plus subsequent Korean follow-up; details remain contested and should be presented as talks/reporting rather than a completed deal.

items.event_title: Zuckerberg rejects coordinated AI slowdown and argues labs can manage safety individually
items.news_summary: Mark Zuckerberg said competition and liability give AI labs sufficient incentive to move at a safe pace individually, diverging from calls by leaders including Anthropic's Dario Amodei for a coordinated slowdown.
items.investor_materiality: The dispute affects AI development pace, regulation risk and capital-spending expectations across Meta and the broader U.S. AI complex.
items.selection_reason: A clean strategic split among leading AI companies with direct implications for the pace of model development and regulation.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters reporting based on Zuckerberg's public comments.
items.youtube_query: Meta Zuckerberg AI slowdown safety Anthropic
items.video_angle: AI巨头公开分裂：Anthropic想减速，Meta为什么坚决不同意

items.event_title: EU chief backs AI slowdown talks with frontier labs
items.news_summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen backed calls to slow frontier-AI development and said she would invite major labs to discuss risk controls.
items.investor_materiality: Raises the probability of tighter European constraints on frontier-model development and creates regulatory risk for U.S. AI platforms and cloud providers.
items.selection_reason: Turns the AI-slowdown debate from an industry argument into a potential major-market policy catalyst.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters coverage of the European Commission president's annual address.
items.youtube_query: EU AI slowdown frontier labs regulation September 2026
items.video_angle: 欧洲也支持AI减速：这会不会真的打断OpenAI、Anthropic和Meta的军备竞赛

items.event_title: ByteDance AI-drug spin-off Anew Labs raises $290 million at $1.5 billion valuation
items.news_summary: ByteDance's spun-off AI drug-discovery unit Anew Labs completed a $290 million external fundraising at a $1.5 billion valuation, with ByteDance retaining a 56% stake, according to Reuters sources.
items.investor_materiality: Shows large Chinese internet groups monetizing and separately financing AI verticals, with implications for AI-biotech valuations and Chinese private-market capital.
items.selection_reason: Large, identifiable AI financing event with major venture investors and a clear ByteDance linkage.
items.youtube_query: ByteDance Anew Labs AI drug 290 million funding
items.video_angle: 字节跳动把AI制药单独融资：为什么AI下一场资本战可能不在聊天机器人

items.event_title: Starbucks considers selling majority stake in Japan business
items.news_summary: Starbucks is considering a majority sale of its Japan operation at an indicated valuation around $3 billion, according to Reuters sources, as management continues reshaping its international portfolio.
items.investor_materiality: Japan is Starbucks' largest overseas company-operated market; a sale could simplify the portfolio, raise cash and change international earnings exposure.
items.selection_reason: Potentially material portfolio restructuring at a large U.S. consumer company following its China divestment.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters source-based M&A reporting; transaction is under consideration, not completed.
items.youtube_query: Starbucks SBUX Japan majority stake sale 3 billion
items.video_angle: 星巴克卖完中国又考虑卖日本？这到底是在收缩还是给美国业务输血

items.event_title: BOJ expected to lift rates to 1.25%, a 31-year high
items.news_summary: The Bank of Japan is expected to raise its policy rate to 1.25% on Friday as oil and yen weakness keep inflation pressure elevated.
items.investor_materiality: Further Japanese tightening can affect the yen carry trade, global bond yields, Japanese equities and cross-border liquidity relevant to U.S. risk assets.
items.selection_reason: Major global-liquidity catalyst arriving alongside expected Fed tightening.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters macro reporting with market expectations and policymaker context.
items.youtube_query: Bank of Japan BOJ 1.25 rate hike yen carry trade
items.video_angle: 日本利率升到31年新高：日元套利交易会不会再次冲击美股

items.event_title: SK hynix union approves revised wage agreement
items.news_summary: SK hynix's production-worker union approved a revised wage and bonus agreement, ending weeks of uncertainty after rejecting an earlier deal.
items.investor_materiality: Reduces near-term labor disruption risk at a critical HBM and memory supplier during exceptionally strong AI-driven demand.
items.selection_reason: A concrete supply-chain risk resolution at one of the world's most important AI-memory suppliers.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters report citing the company and union vote results.
items.youtube_query: SK hynix union wage deal HBM memory
items.video_angle: SK海力士劳资风险解除：HBM供应链少了一个隐患，但成本会不会上升

items.event_title: EU says it will use all tools to reduce China trade deficit
items.news_summary: EU Commission President von der Leyen said Europe would use available tools to address its roughly 1 billion euro-per-day trade deficit with China and reduce critical-mineral dependencies.
items.investor_materiality: Potentially affects autos, batteries, industrials, semiconductors and critical-mineral supply chains spanning China, Europe and U.S.-listed multinationals.
items.selection_reason: Broad trade-policy signal with direct supply-chain and tariff implications beyond Europe.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters coverage of official EU policy remarks.
items.youtube_query: EU China trade deficit critical minerals tariffs September 2026
items.video_angle: 欧洲要对中国贸易逆差动真格：汽车、稀土和半导体供应链谁先受影响

items.event_title: Intel-veteran chip startup Delos Data raises $100 million for AI networking
items.news_summary: Delos Data raised $100 million to build chips and software for moving data inside increasingly heterogeneous AI data centers, targeting a bottleneck created as Nvidia, AMD and other accelerators coexist.
items.investor_materiality: Highlights networking and interconnect as a growing AI infrastructure bottleneck and supports the thesis that value is broadening beyond GPUs.
items.selection_reason: Fresh financing event with a strong investable read-through to AI networking, data-center efficiency and accelerator competition.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters interview/reporting with company executives and investors.
items.youtube_query: Delos Data AI networking chips 100 million Nvidia AMD
